Summary: Cai dat R-LIMIT-01 han muc ngay doc tu limit_config
Description: Han muc ngay 50.000.000d phai doc tu bang limit_config trong paymentdb, khong hard-code trong LimitPolicy. Tong tinh gom ca giao dich dang giu.

Summary: Cai dat R-REVIEW-01 nguong ra soat va publish PaymentHeld
Description: Amount quy doi VND tu 20.000.000d tro len thi dat trang thai HELD, giu tien, VA publish event PaymentHeld. Hai hanh dong nay di cung nhau, thieu mot la vi pham.

Summary: Cai dat R-CURRENCY-01 quy doi tien te truoc khi ap han muc
Description: Handler gRPC AuthorizePayment phai doc field currency tu request, tra fx_rates, tinh amount_vnd, roi moi ap R-AMOUNT-02 R-LIMIT-01 R-REVIEW-01. Khong duoc gan cung currency=VND.

Summary: Cai dat R-FX-01 va R-FX-02 luu ca amount goc va amount_vnd
Description: payment_transactions luu ca hai gia tri. ledger_entries ghi bang VND theo amount_vnd.

Summary: Cai dat R-LEDGER-01 but toan kep can bang
Description: Moi transaction duoc authorize sinh dung 2 ledger_entries: 1 DEBIT 1 CREDIT cung txn_id, tong bang 0.

Summary: Cai dat R-LEDGER-02 bu tru bang but toan nguoc
Description: Khong sua hoac xoa but toan goc. Chi them but toan nguoc chieu voi txn_id moi va entry_type=REFUND.

Summary: Cai dat R-EVENT-01 va R-EVENT-02 publish event
Description: Moi transaction vao trang thai ket thuc publish dung 1 event len ewallet.payment.events voi key la orderId. Bon trang thai ket thuc: CAPTURED REJECTED HELD REVERSED.

Summary: Cai dat R-USAGE-01 va R-USAGE-02 tich luy va hoan han muc
Description: Authorize hoac HELD thi cong amount_vnd vao daily_usage. Reverse thi tru lai amount_vnd cua NGAY GOC, khong phai ngay hom nay.

Summary: Cai dat R-IDEM-01 den R-IDEM-03 chong trung request
Description: Thieu X-Idempotency-Key tra 400. Trung key cung payload tra lai ket qua cu. Trung key khac payload tra 409 DUPLICATE_REQUEST. Unique index uq_orders_idem.

Summary: Cai dat R-COMP-01 luon bu tru sau khi da giu tien
Description: Bat ky buoc nao sau AUTHORIZE that bai thi orchestrator BAT BUOC goi ReversePayment truoc khi tra loi cho client.

Summary: Cai dat R-COMP-04 khong nuot loi bu tru
Description: ReversePayment that bai thi order chuyen FAILED voi reason_code COMPENSATION_FAILED va log muc ERROR. Khong duoc im lang.
Goi nhieu lan cho cung txn_id thi lan 2 tro di tra ket qua cu, khong sinh but toan moi.

Summary: Cai dat R-HIST-06 truy van gop thay vi lap
Description: Lay order_steps cua nhieu don bang MOT truy van IN hoac JOIN. Khong lap truy van theo tung don. Tong so cau SQL cho mot lan goi API khong duoc vuot qua 2.
Migration phai tao index payment_orders(customer_id, created_at) va order_steps(order_id). Thieu index thi moi truy van la seq scan.

Summary: Cai dat R-NOTIF-03 va R-NOTIF-04 retry va dead letter
Description: Retry toi da 3 lan backoff 1s 2s 4s, tang header x-attempt. Het luot thi chuyen ewallet.payment.events.DLT va ghi result DEAD_LETTER.

Summary: Cai dat R-NOTIF-05 chong trung thong bao
Description: Unique index uq_outbox_event_channel_customer tren (event_id, channel, customer_id). Phai co customer_id vi P2P bao cho ca hai ben qua cung kenh PUSH.

Summary: Cai dat R-ORDST-02 khong ghi de trang thai terminal
Description: Consumer order-status-cg chi cap nhat trang thai khi trang thai moi hop le. Trang thai hien tai da terminal khac thi bo qua va log WARN.

Summary: Bao dam NFR-LAT-01 duoi 500ms cho AuthorizePayment
Description: p95 cua span gRPC AuthorizePayment phai duoi 500ms tren moi nhanh, ke ca nhanh HELD. Khong duoc co thao tac cham dong bo trong duong nay.
